paite: David adamsawt in a-upa mahmah a; huchi in Israelte kumpipa in atapa Solomon abawlta hi.
heading: Levite Nasep

paite: Huan Israelte makai tengteng siampute leh Levite toh asamkhawm hi.
Levite kum sawmthum a kipan atunglam sim ahi ua; atamlam uh piching singthum-le-sanggiat ahi.
Huaite lak a, "Singnih-le-sangli TOUPA' inn lam heutute heutu ding ahi ua; sanggukte heutute leh vaihawmmi dingte ahi uh;
Sanglite kongkhak ngak mite ding ahi ua, huan sanglite, phatna ding a thil tumging chi ka bawl," David in achihte zang a TOUPA phat ding mite ahi uhi.
Levi tapate Gershon, Kahath, Merari zah in David in pawl abawl a,
Gershon mite Laadan leh Shimei ahi uh.
Laadan tapate makaipente Jehiel, Zetham, Joel, thum ahi uh.
Shimei tapate Shelomith, Haziel, Haran, thum ahi uh. Hiaite Laadan suan inkuan makaipente ahi uh.
Shimei tapate bel Jahath, Zina, Jeush, Beriah ahi uh. Hiai lite Shimei tapate ahi uh.
Jahath a-upapen ahi a, Zizah anihna ahi; Jeush leh Beriahte'n bel ta ahau kei ua; huaiziak in inkuan khat bang a sim ahi uh.
Kohath tapate Amram, Izhar, Hebron, Uzziel, li ahi uh.

Amram tapate Aaron leh Mosi ahi uh; Aaron bel amah leh asuante tangtawn a ding a thil siangthoutakte hihsiangthou a, tangtawn a TOUPA ma a gimlim hal a, a-nna sem a, amin a vualzawlpa ding a hihtuam ahi uh.
Pathian mipa Mosi bel, atapate Levi nam lak a sim ahi uh.
Mosi tapate Gershom leh Eliezer ahi uh,
Gershom tapate lak a upapen Shebuel ahi.
Eliezer tapate lak a upapen Rehabiah ahi. Eliezer in tapa dang anei kei; Rehabiah in bel tapa tampi anei.
Izhar tapate: Shelmoth amakai lianpen.
Hebron tapate lak a makai lianpen Jeriah ahi a, anihna Amariah, athumna Jahaziel, alina Jekameam ahi.
Uzziel tapate lak a upazaw Mikah ahi a, anihna Isshiah ahi.
Merari tapate: Merari tapate bel Mahli leh Mushi ahi uh, Mahli tapate Eleazar leh Kish ahi uh.
Eleazar tapate nei lou in asi a, tanute kia anei a; Kish tapa a-unaute un zi in anei uh.
Mushi tapate Mahli, Eder, Jeremoth, thum ahi uh.
Huaite Levi suan a-inkuan uh bang zel a min gelh a asim uh inkuan makaipen, TOUPA' inn lam a kuan, kuni sawmnih a kipan tunglam asimte uh ahi.
David in, "TOUPA, Israel' Pathian in amite galmuangtak in a-omsakta a, Jerusalem ah a-om nilouh hi.
Levite'n leng biakbuk leh anasepna ding tui-um belsuan tengteng azon uh akiphamohta kei hi," achi hi.
David thupiak nanung ziak in Levite kum sawmnih a kipan atunglam tan in sim ngal ahi uhi.
Anasep uh Pathian inn a nasep a Aaron tapate panpih a intual sung leh dantan sung a thil siangthoute hihsiangthou a, TOUPA' inn a nasep ahi;
tanghou koih dingte, tangbuang thillat ding a tangbuang nel mahmah, silngou hel louh tanghou pek hiam, bel a uk hiam, kan hiam, ateh leh aletdan bang teng ding bawlte toh;
Zingsang teng a TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen leh amah phatte toh, nitak a leng huchi mah;
Sabbathte, kha thakte a ankuanglui neihte ahih ding seh bang zel a TOUPA kiang a halmang thillat tengteng TOUPA ma a lat gigete toh;
kihoupihna biakbuk kepte, mun siangthou kepte, TOUPA' inn a nasem a a-unau Aaron tapate'n hih ding aseh peuhmah uh hihte toh.
